name: PlayCanvas Third Person Controller
description: Reusable first-party PlayCanvas third-person character controller with keyboard/mouse, touch, gamepad, camera orbit/collision, jumping, locomotion and animation events.

licence.notice: Controller is stored in the official PlayCanvas engine repository, whose source is MIT licensed. Preserve the MIT notice for copied/substantial source portions.

provenance.notes: First-party source in the official PlayCanvas engine repository, pinned to an exact commit.

maintenance.evidence: Controller is present in the current official engine repository and uses current PlayCanvas InputFrame input sources.
maintenance.notes: Revalidate against the engine version selected by BYJTT-LAB-001 before promotion.

compatibility.notes: Source explicitly implements keyboard/mouse, DualGesture touch input and gamepad input; execution on the target mobile-shaped viewport is still required.

risk.legalNotes: MIT code reuse is commercially compatible; preserve required copyright/licence notice. Any separate model, audio or art used by a consuming example must be licensed independently.
risk.securityNotes: First-party engine script with no separate package dependency; still review imported code and engine version normally.

assessment.notes: Directly overlaps BYJTT-LAB-001 movement/camera/touch requirements and should be benchmarked before bespoke PlayCanvas controller work.

evidence.notes: Pinned first-party controller source documents movement, camera, keyboard/mouse, touch and gamepad support.

publication.notes: May publish factual source/licence data and BYJTT benchmark results after execution; do not imply production promotion before the bake-off.
